text: {"title":"Query Load","timeRange":{"from":"now-1h","to":"now"},"refreshIntervalMs":15000,"panels":[{"id":"qps-by-source","title":"Queries per second by source","viz":"line","description":"Per-second rate of panel queries, grouped by the query source label.","query":{"sourceId":"eval-prometheus-demo","promql":"sum by (source) (rate(holotable_query_duration_seconds_count[5m]))"},"layout":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":6,"h":4},"options":{"unit":"qps","decimals":2,"legend":"bottom"}},{"id":"p95-latency","title":"p95 query latency","viz":"line","description":"95th percentile of panel query latency in seconds, computed from the latency histogram buckets over time.","query":{"sourceId":"eval-prometheus-demo","promql":"histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(holotable_query_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))"},"layout":{"x":6,"y":0,"w":6,"h":4},"options":{"unit":"s","decimals":3,"legend":"none"}},{"id":"outcome-share","title":"Query outcome share","viz":"donut","description":"Share of panel queries in the window grouped by outcome, showing how many failed versus succeeded.","query":{"sourceId":"eval-prometheus-demo","promql":"sum by (outcome) (increase(holotable_query_duration_seconds_count[1h]))","instant":true},"layout":{"x":0,"y":4,"w":6,"h":4},"options":{"decimals":1,"compact":true,"legend":"right"}}]}
